cues.show: You with the guitar, the game on screen before Start.
cues.say: This game is for learning where the notes are on the neck.

cues.show: Point at the tags above the game: the strings, the frets, the kind of question.
cues.say: The tags at the top say what the game will ask: which strings, which frets, and whether it wants one note or every place a note sits.

cues.show: Press Start. Answer a few by tapping the neck on screen.
cues.say: Press Start below to get the first note. Find it on the guitar first, then tap the same place on the neck on the screen.

cues.show: Press Start. Answer a few by tapping the neck on screen.
cues.say: The game says whether it was right, and names the note you tapped if it wasn't.

cues.show: Press Hear the note, then Skip on another one.
cues.say: Press Hear the note to listen to the note the game asked for. Press Skip to leave one and get the next.

cues.show: On the guitar: open string, then count up the frets, saying the names.
cues.say: Here is a way to find any note. Start from the open string and say the names as you go up, one fret at a time.

cues.show: On the guitar: open string, then count up the frets, saying the names.
cues.say: B to C and E to F are one fret apart. Every other pair of letters is two frets apart.

cues.show: Press Playing it (mic) and answer one on the guitar. Then say the note names aloud while playing.
cues.say: Try things with it. Press Playing it (mic), then Start microphone, and answer by playing the note on your guitar.

cues.show: Press Playing it (mic) and answer one on the guitar. Then say the note names aloud while playing.
cues.say: Say each note's name aloud as you play it.

cues.show: Press Playing it (mic) and answer one on the guitar. Then say the note names aloud while playing.
cues.say: Find the same note on two strings and listen: is it the same note, or one higher?

cues.show: Press Playing it (mic) and answer one on the guitar. Then say the note names aloud while playing.
cues.say: The goal of this practice is to find a note without counting up from the open string.
